text:
Perfect! I've successfully authenticated your identity. Now I can help you with your skateboard return. 

You mentioned you'd like to return two skateboards from an order. Could you please provide your order number so I can look up the details and help you process the return?
zh:
太好了！我已經成功核實了你的身份。現在我可以幫你處理滑板退貨了。 

你提到你想退回一個訂單中的兩個滑板。你能提供你的訂單號，以便我查詢詳情並幫助你處理退貨嗎？(滑板 #W1234567)
